note: Source of truth for Prism II exercises + weights. Keep ids stable (history is keyed on them). Bump version on every edit.

Upper.name: Chest Press
Upper.cue: Warm up first: one easy set of ~8 at 80. Full ROM, controlled descent, no elbow slam.

Upper.name: Cable Rope Row
Upper.safety: Right inner shoulder. Stop at the first pinch.
Upper.cue: Pull to the waist, elbows close, squeeze the blades, slow return. 130 needs 12 on all five.

Upper.name: Incline Press
Upper.safety: Stop on any rotator-cuff pain. Nothing gets pushed through.
Upper.cue: Seat at the incline setting. Lower to the upper chest, elbows ~45°, press up and slightly back. Third set is new.

Upper.name: Chest Fly
Upper.safety: Cuff and right inner shoulder. The bottom of the arc is where it loads.
Upper.cue: Discovery. Single-arm cable fly, 15 a side: arm long, soft elbow, hand past the body line, 3-sec negative. Pec deck ~50 if there is one.

Upper.name: Tricep Pushdown
Upper.cue: Elbows pinned, full lockout, control the negative. French press at 40 if the station is taken.

Upper.name: DB Lateral Raise
Upper.safety: Right inner shoulder. Stop at the first pinch. Left clicks above parallel.
Upper.cue: Lead with the elbows, raise to parallel and no higher, no swing.

Upper.name: DB Curls
Upper.safety: Supinated grip only. Hammer twangs the nerve. A twang is the only stop.
Upper.cue: Supinated is nerve-safe, so failure is fine. Controlled, no swinging.

Lower.name: Leg Press
Lower.safety: Stop the descent at 90°. Never knees-to-chest. Sharp medial knee pain ends the session.
Lower.cue: Controlled descent to 90°, drive through the heels. 205 cleared 12x4 on 9/06.

Lower.name: Leg Press Calf Raise
Lower.safety: Anything sharp in the knee is a knee signal. Stop.
Lower.cue: Full stretch at the bottom, pause at the top.

Lower.name: Cable Face Pull
Lower.safety: Right shoulder is active. Stop at the first pinch.
Lower.cue: Rope to the face, elbows high, pull apart at the end. Shoulder health, not a size lift.

Lower.name: Cable Lateral Raise
Lower.safety: Right inner shoulder. Stop at the first pinch.
Lower.cue: Cable, not dumbbells. Lead with the elbow, to parallel and no higher, no swing.

Lower.name: Lying Leg Curl
Lower.safety: Hard stop on ANY medial-thigh sensation. Not pain, any sensation. Rack it.
Lower.cue: The canary. 10-lb stack. Slow, full curl, no hip lift. Now on the ladder - any medial-thigh sensation still ends it.

Lower.name: Leg Extension
Lower.cue: 10-lb stack. Squeeze at the top, control the way down, no bouncing off the stop.

Lower.name: Lying Crunch (bodyweight)
Lower.safety: Right rib pain ends the set. Bodyweight only now, no machine. Crunch from the ribs with the hips fixed. Never hinge. Stop on any low-back signal.
Lower.cue: Lying on the floor, knees bent, curl the ribs toward the pelvis, 2-sec squeeze. Bodyweight to failure. The machine gave right rib pain 9/06 - do not go back to it.
